name: 9-Inch Heavy Duty Paint Roller with Microfibre Roller Sleeve
shortDescription: Heavy-duty 9-inch 5-wire cage paint roller frame with high-density shed-resistant microfibre sleeve and threaded handle for telescopic extension poles.
overview: The 9-Inch Heavy Duty Paint Roller system is built for rapid, flawless coverage across large industrial wall surfaces, structural steel plates, and epoxy floor coatings. Engineered around a heavy-gauge 8mm chrome-plated 5-wire steel cage that eliminates roller slippage and wobble, it is fitted with a premium high-density shed-resistant microfibre sleeve (12mm medium pile). The microfibre core absorbs massive paint volume and transfers it evenly across smooth to semi-rough surfaces without spattering or leave lint behind.
keyFeatures: 9-inch (225mm) width covers large surface areas quickly with uniform thickness
High-density shed-resistant microfibre sleeve provides massive paint pickup and release
Heavy 8mm chrome-plated steel frame with 5-wire cage prevents sleeve slippage
Internal nylon bearings ensure ultra-smooth, low-friction rolling action
Low-spatter microfibre structure keeps painter and workspace clean
Ergonomic handle features an internal screw thread compatible with telescopic extension poles
Sleeve is easily washed and reusable across dozens of painting jobs

specifications.Frame Wire Diameter: 8 mm Chrome Plated Heavy Steel Rod
specifications.Handle Connection: Universal Threaded Socket for Extension Poles
specifications.Compatible Coatings: Interior/Exterior Emulsions, Enamels, Epoxy Floor Primers

applications: Painting commercial warehouse masonry walls and concrete ceilings
Applying epoxy primer and floor paint in industrial plant bays
Rapid painting of large steel container panels and storage tanks
Exterior facade acrylic painting and concrete sealing
